source.title: A neural coding scheme formed by the combined function of gamma and theta oscillations.

confidence_rationale: Grounds the completion-set partner HPL-9 named for MECH-148: theta-gamma nesting is the oscillatory code that orders items/events in a temporal sequence -- the substrate that a per-step elapsed-time tag plugs into. Confidence moderate because the scheme codes ORDERED ITEM sequences (rank), which is adjacent to but not identical with MECH-148's pure context-independent ELAPSED-TIME signal.
failure_signatures: Theta-gamma coding represents the ORDINAL position of items in a sequence (which item is 1st, 2nd, ...), not a metric elapsed-time-since-event scalar. MECH-148's pure time cells encode elapsed duration; the theta-gamma partner supplies ordering/segmentation, so the two are complementary, not interchangeable -- conflating them would mis-specify the substrate.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Theta and gamma oscillations work together to form a neural code in which multiple neural ensembles represent an ORDERED SEQUENCE of items: each gamma cycle within a theta cycle holds one item, giving items a rank order; in the hippocampus this underlies phase precession (recall of ordered place sequences).
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds the oscillatory temporal-ordering partner MECH-148 presupposes. Pure time cells supply a content-free elapsed-time axis; theta-gamma nesting supplies the ORDERING/segmentation of events within a rollout. A REE rollout module that weights outcomes by temporal distance needs both: the elapsed-time scalar (MECH-148) to set discounting magnitude AND a sequence-ordering code to keep multi-step rollout events in correct rank. Also corroborates REE's existing MECH-089 theta-gamma nesting claim.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The theta-gamma code is ORDINAL (item rank within a sequence), whereas MECH-148's pure time cells are a METRIC elapsed-time signal. They are complementary partners, not the same quantity -- this entry grounds the ordering partner, not MECH-148's core elapsed-time construct (which Omer/Las/Ulanovsky 2022 grounds).
mapping.source_context: Theoretical review synthesising rodent hippocampal oscillation physiology (theta phase precession, gamma item-coding) with human short-term-memory and schizophrenia evidence.

confidence_components.notes: Canonical Lisman & Buzsaki theta-gamma synthesis. Mapping fidelity moderate: grounds the ordering/segmentation partner (ordinal), complementary to MECH-148's metric elapsed-time core. Conservative single tag (MECH-148) though it also corroborates MECH-089.
